alternatives: Neo4j vector index (adds infra, breaks determinism); hosted embedding APIs (cloud dependency, nondeterministic drift); no semantic search at all.
consequences: Retrieval quality without embeddings depends on names, signatures, and agent-written summaries - enriching summaries directly improves search. Any future corpus addition (e.g. decision records) must keep a deterministic lexical path.
context: Semantic retrieval could use Neo4j vector indexes or hosted embedding services, but both break RepoSkein's core guarantees: determinism (same code, byte-identical graph) and zero-infra (no database, no cloud dependency). Industry code-embedding offerings were abandoned or unreliable for this use.
decided_by: marcus (ratified in session, recorded by claude)
decision: semantic_find is lexical (BM25F) by default and deterministic. Embeddings are an optional, local-only enhancement (REPOSKEIN_EMBED_PROVIDER with the local embed-server); when configured, hybrid RRF reranking applies and the response discloses ranking hybrid. No Neo4j vector indexes, no hosted embedding APIs.
title: No hosted vector DB for semantic search; local-only embeddings, lexical fallback
